note: HSBC Macau's bank tariff guide for Wealth and Personal Banking customers (effective 1 April 2025): its deposit accounts section charges for cheques, returns and closing within three months, but carries no monthly maintenance or below-balance fee for a savings or statement savings account. Bank of China (Macau)'s and BNU's tariffs weren't found.
